name: Popiah
summary: A long, soft fresh spring roll of thin wheat crepe wrapped round braised sengkuang (jicama), lettuce and egg over a smear of sweet sauce and chilli, cut across into six pieces that lie on their sides in a gentle arc on an oval plate, still touching as they were cut: the pale wrinkled crepe along the roll, the filling at the cut ends, dark sweet sauce smeared over the top and pooling, crushed peanuts scattered over.
notes: Shown as it ships in KL Rush, compressed for the web (meshopt geometry and, where it has textures, KTX2). A download copy will be exported from source once the model is cleared.
